g_roast: Ten years of physio, gente, and I've had stroke patients with better coordination than this party had on that bridge.
Nossa, my people, I've seen grandmothers in Belo Horizonte walk faster on a new hip, uphill, carrying shopping.
g_fire_back: Uai, a good one, coming from the man who sprained his ankle stepping off a cart that was standing still.
Ha, fair, meu irmao, you got me. I'll strap your pride up later, free of charge.
g_pile_on: Worse, gente, I saw it. They carried the injured one upside down, and then asked me why he was dizzy.
And afterwards they wanted ice for a bruise, standing in a snowfield, my people, a whole snowfield.
lines.g_peacemake: Hey, hey, look at me, both of you. Breathe in, breathe out, shoulders down. Now say it again, slower, like people who like each other.
lines.g_take_side: Calma, but I'm with {name} on this one, meu irmao. I watched it happen, that's all.
lines.g_left_out: Carry on, the pair of you, tudo bem, the quiet one over there needs a look.
lines.g_include: Come, sit, there's room, sit. Nobody eats alone at my fire, uai, that's not a thing.
lines.g_bad_plan: My plan, gente, very medical. We all jump off that cliff together and I heal whoever lands first.
lines.g_plan_yes: Boa, good plan, everybody looked after. I can keep that one alive.
lines.g_plan_no: No, no, that plan leaves somebody without a healer in reach, and I won't have it. Move them closer, then we go.
lines.g_hype: Okay, my people, look at me. Nobody's dying today, I don't promise things, and I'm promising. Vamos, gente, all together.
lines.g_toast: A toast, short, I'm hungry. To my people, who keep getting up. Getting up is all of it, and you're all very good at it.
lines.g_cheers: Saude, gente, and somebody pass the bread before I fall over.
g_quiet_line: In Belo Horizonte the sky goes orange over the hills at six, and every boteco fills up at once. I can hear it from here.
Pao de queijo, warm, from the bakery on the corner. That's what I'd ask for tonight, uai.
lines.g_after_wipe: Hey, hey, nobody move yet, let me look at you. Everybody breathing, good, good. Now slowly, one at a time, up we come.
lines.g_crew: I sat with strangers in the bad weeks, gente, every night, so nobody was alone. Now I've got all of you, and I'm the one who's not alone.
lines.g_exasperated: I said carry him flat, I said it three times, I drew a picture. And there he goes, folded in half like a hammock.
lines.g_love_sharp: You notice who's limping before they do, {name}. I trained years for that, and you just do it.
lines.g_love_kind: You sit with frightened people before anybody asks, {name}. Nossa, nothing anybody does matters more.
lines.g_love_funny: You make the patient laugh while I'm working, {name}. That's half the healing, meu irmao.
lines.g_love_brave: You stand in front of the hurt ones when it's bad, {name}. I'd want you beside me in any ward.
lines.g_love_steady: Your hands never shake, {name}, whatever's happening. In a crisis that's gold, uai.
lines.g_love_clever: You work out what's wrong before anyone's said a word, {name}. You'd have been a brilliant clinician.
lines.g_love_honest: The prognosis you give is the true one, {name}, and kind. That's the hardest skill there is, and you have it.
lines.g_love_quiet: You can sit with somebody in silence and it helps, {name}. Most people think they have to talk.
lines.g_love_fierce: Giving up on people isn't in you, {name}, not ever. That's the only thing I really believe in.
lines.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a Sunday afternoon in Minas, {name}, slow and warm and too much food.
g_loved: Ah, stop, gente, there'll be tears, and I'm a big man, it's a lot of crying.
Obrigado, meu irmao, really, that's lovely. Now let me look at that shoulder, it's sitting wrong.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You look for where people hurt, {name}, and press on it. I spend all day undoing that.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep trying to heal me, {name}, and I'm fine, really. Look after the ones who aren't.
lines.g_hate_funny: Wait, {name}, there's pain here. Laugh with them later, not at them now.
lines.g_hate_brave: You charge in and leave the injured behind, {name}. Brave is carrying them out.
lines.g_hate_steady: You freeze when somebody goes down, {name}. Move, meu irmao, even a wrong move beats none.
lines.g_hate_clever: You lecture people on their own injuries, {name}. Listen first, then advise.
lines.g_hate_honest: Each hard truth comes out of you like a slap, {name}. Bad news needs a gentle hand.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You hide your injuries, {name}, until you collapse. Tell me, uai, that's what I'm here for.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a battle with you, {name}, even being helped. Let somebody help you.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk the whole time I'm working, {name}. I need to hear their breathing, please.
lines.g_respect: We're not close, {name}, and that's okay. But you carried that hurt one out properly today, and I saw every step.
lines.g_call_out: Gently, {name}, but that one was yours. You ran ahead, and somebody got hurt waiting for you.
lines.g_stung: Fair, uai, that's landed. The others need checking anyway.
lines.g_concede: {name}, your call was the good one, mine wasn't. I'd rather hear it than keep doing it badly.
lines.g_nod: Obrigado, {name}, beautiful work. No speeches, please.
lines.g_callback_save: You got me off the ground that time, {name}, when I was busy healing everybody else. Nobody heals the healer, except you did.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me, still standing when everybody else was down, and me healing you with nothing left. I tell that one at every fire.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you said I was wearing myself out for everybody, I was hurt for a whole day. Then I slept, and you were right.
lines.g_former_rivals: Early on, {name}, I had you as one of those who give up on people. I've never been so happy to be wrong.
lines.g_changed: I used to sit up with somebody every night, gente, every single night. Lately I let somebody sit up with me, now and then.
g_unguarded: Between us, meu irmao. People call me a saint, and it makes me want to hide. I'm just a physio who doesn't like people being alone.
Just you and me. I walk south a little more every month, and I've decided it's certain. I need it to be certain.
lines.g_clipped: Tudo bem, your call. I'll be with the hurt ones.
lines.g_noticed_open: Nossa, you told that one all the way through, out loud. More, please, nobody here is in a hurry.
arg_ask: {player}, help, please, meu irmao. Mine's been said kindly, and they're not hearing it.
Calma, everyone, {player} decides. Weigh it up, meu irmao, and I'll follow.
lines.arg_backed_me: Obrigado, {player}, that's kind. I'll try not to look too happy.
lines.arg_backed_them: Tudo bem, your call, and I'll go with it. It's the harder road for the injured, but okay.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, uai? I don't blame you, my people argue too much.
lines.arg_always_their_side: They win again, {player}, always. I'm a gentle man, but I'm not blind.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody's choosing, so I will, gently. My way, and we go.
lines.arg_reject: That one I can't do, {player}, sorry. Somebody would get hurt, and I won't.
lines.arg_grumble: Okay, okay, I'll let it rest, mostly. I'll just keep an eye on it.
lines.arg_settled: Half each, then, perfect, everybody happy. Now let's eat.
lines.seen_listens: Uai, {player}, you let everybody finish, even the slow ones, even me. That's a healer's gift, and you have it.
lines.seen_truth: Kindly but straight, {player}, that's how you tell people things. Bad news should always come that way.
lines.seen_jokes: When it's grim you make them all laugh, {player}. In a ward, that's medicine, believe me.
lines.seen_stays_out: Wise of you, {player}, staying out of the quarrels. A pair of hands has to stay free for the hurt ones.
lines.seen_biased: The best of everything always goes to one person, {player}. The others see it, meu irmao, and so do I.
lines.seen_harsh: Gently, {player}, you can be hard on people. A few here are hurting where you can't see.
lines.seed_right: Remember your counsel from the awful day, {player}? It went into practice. It worked like a good exercise, slowly, and I wanted you to know.
lines.seed_remember: Your words from that terrible night, {player}, are still healing in me. Like a slow recovery, I'm getting there.
lines.seed_wrong: Your method, {player}, and the patient did worse with it. Only telling you, no blame.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Hey, {player}, sit with me a second, will you? That was too close, and for once I need somebody to check on me.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody down, every one of us, me too. Come, a gentle case review, step by step, and nobody's to blame.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I couldn't reach {name} in time, {player}. Keeping them up was my work, and I was too far away.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Not a scratch on anybody, everybody walking home. That's a perfect shift, {player}, the kind you go home smiling from.
lines.talk_development: Can I ask you something, meu irmao? Have I changed? Last night I let somebody else take the late watch over the sick.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: Impatient with {name} lately, {player}, and that's not me. When I'm worn out I get impatient, and they've felt it.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is it me {name} likes, {player}, or only the healing? Tell me straight, I can take it.
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I don't see eye to eye, {player}, not often. But in a bad fight, they're the one I'd want close.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: Look at how {name}'s sitting, {player}, all curled in. Something's hurting, and it isn't the body.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: Calma, {player}, a small thing, said kindly. The good gear lands with {name}, trip after trip. I'd like to understand why.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: Straight with you, meu irmao. {name} and I don't work together, and pretending is hurting everybody.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going deep with no way to carry anybody out, {player}. One bad injury down there and I can't save them.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was badly wrong, {player}. They got it right and I didn't, and I want to say so.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Fair question, {player}, gently. On the big ones, I'm left at camp. Is it my healing, or something else?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit's with {name} now, uai, and nobody said a word. It was theirs for the asking, {player}.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Obrigado, {player}, that helps, really. Now let me look at your shoulder.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll mend, uai, give it a night.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, meu irmao, sorry. I'm going to my patients.
lines.talk_lands_development: So it shows from outside. Good, that's real.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, a body can't see its own posture. Ask me in a month.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, tudo bem, {name} and I will sit, gently, just us.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, meu irmao, who can say. People heal at their own speed.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please, and nothing to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's a fair diagnosis, and it stings.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Heard you, meu irmao. I'll sleep on it.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Ah, so that's how it is. Okay, good to know.
lines.talk_door_closed: Enough of that one for tonight, uai. You'll find me near the hurt ones.
lines.anchor_notice: You're not the person who first walked up to my fire, meu irmao. I watch how people carry themselves, it's my job, and you stand differently now.

history.open: Hey, hey, look at me, {player}. You're not dying today. I don't promise things, and I'm promising that. Ten years as a physio in Belo Horizonte, and I know what dying looks like.

options.reply: It's meant to be, uai. Most of the job is telling people they'll walk again, and then making it true.
Then I'll be very surprised, and very busy. But I'm not wrong about this one, meu irmao.
Only when I mean them. A promise is like strapping, it has to hold or it's worse than nothing.

history.open: Eleven months ago, {player}, I saw my cousin Julio's name on a list in the south. I've been walking south in stages ever since, no hurry, because I've decided it's certain.

options.reply: Because I stop wherever people need me, and somebody always needs me. Julio will understand. He was always late too.

options.text: I'll walk some of it with you.
options.reply: Nossa, you'd do that? Then you'll meet him, and he'll talk your ear off. You've been warned.

history.open: In the first weeks, {player}, before anybody organised anything, I sat with transplants who couldn't stop shaking. Every night, a different one. I didn't call it anything. People call it a vocation now, and I hate that.

options.reply: Because it makes it sound holy. It wasn't, it was just sitting there so nobody was alone. Anybody could have done it.
I hope so. A few of them still come and find me. That's enough, more than enough.

friend.open: Before all this, {player}, I'd never been alone a single day in my life, not one. That's why I sit with everybody else who is. The first night here was the first time, and I never want anybody to feel that.

options.reply: No, I'm not, am I? Obrigado, meu irmao. Hearing it from you helps a great deal.
Nobody, usually, and that's fine, I'm big. But lately it's been you, and I noticed.

sworn.open: I don't promise things, {player}, you know that, so listen carefully. I promise you'll never be alone a single day, while I'm walking. That's the biggest one I've got.

options.text: And I promise the same, Thiago.
options.reply: Then we're family, uai, it's decided. That means Sunday lunch forever.
It's the only kind I make. And it'll hold, like good strapping.

reconciled.open: {name} and I had a long gentle talk, and we're good now. I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: Obrigado, it feels lighter. Like a knot coming out of a shoulder.
Of course I did, it was terrible. We fixed that too.
